chapter: Chicago, Virginia Ravens and the northern territory bands
title: Joining Eli Rice's band after a dance marathon
summary: Leroy (Eli) Rice, hearing Barefield's seven-piece group at a dance marathon in Menomonie, Wisconsin, took them back to Milwaukee.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: So we went up to Menocwa, Wisconsin to play for a dance marathon, you know, they had in those days. You played and then you took a rest but these people danced around the clock, you know. And while we were in Menocwa, Wisconsin, Leroy Rice from Milwaukee came through with his band. They had guys like Jimmy Dudley and all those guys with his group. And he had a ten piece band but he heard our seven pieces; had

Connie Landers on banjo. He heard our seven pieces and he liked us. So he asked us, would we join him. We said, yes. So he took his ten piece band back to Milwaukee, brought his bus up there and took our seven pieces. Because we were playing all this trombone stuff at that time.

No, we had switched now because we had the typical combination for this stuff, the trombone, and we were playing all that kind of stuff at that time. So he took us, and his band took us back to Milwaukee.
